prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a personality style to see how your companion interacts on your screen.", "Choose Companion Style"]
1: ["How Would You Like Your Companion to Help You Today?", "Choose focus companion mode for quiet work sessions or playful mode for lively desktop check-ins throughout your day."]
2: ["Confirm Your Companion's Personality & Look", "Review your companion's traits before finalizing adoption.", "Confirm Companion"]
3: ["Your Companion is Preparing Their Desk Corner!", "While we build your desktop pet, we've unlocked a Starter Care Pack for your first week together.", "Unlocked: Companion Starter Kit"]
4: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Move In!", "Click launch to place your companion on your screen taskbar.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
5: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Mode", "Focus & Productivity Companion", "Relaxation & Habit Companion"]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate & Trait Selection", "Choose starting habits: Desk Reminders, Water Breaks, High-Fives"]
7: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Screen!", "Press Option/Alt + Space anytime to show or hide your pet. Right-click your pet to open quick actions and settings."]
8: ["Upload Clear, Well-Lit Photos of Your Pet", "For best avatar results, use a centered front-facing photo with good lighting and clear background contrast."]
